papers.title_en: Post-Training Shifts Confidence: A Three-Stage Analysis of How SFT, RL, and OPD Shape Pre-, Intra-, and Post-CoT Calibration
papers.authors: Shuhao Li, Guodong Du, Anhao Zhao, Wanyu Lin, Tianyu Yuan, Xiaoyu Shen
papers.evidence: 分析推理过程中置信度（关键token重要性的代理）的变化
papers.tldr: 大语言模型后训练方法（SFT、RL、OPD）通常仅评估最终答案准确性，忽略推理过程中的置信度校准。本文提出三阶段校准框架，分别评估预推理、推理中和推理后置信度，发现OPD预推理置信度最有用、SFT适合早停、RL轨迹信号最可靠。进一步提出位置感知置信度策略PosConf，利用可靠位置区间，使RL答案聚合提升6.1个百分点，OPD早停在严格令牌预算下提升4.3个百分点。结果表明推理模型的置信度应阶段式且位置感知地使用。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have made strong reasoning gains through supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and on-policy distillation, yet these post-training methods are usually evaluated only by final-answer accuracy. We study how they reshape confidence during reasoning. We introduce a three-stage calibration framework that evaluates confidence before, during, and after chain-of-thought generation, corresponding to difficulty estimation, early termination, and answer aggregation. Through a controlled comparison on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, we find that OPD provides the most useful pre-reasoning confidence, SFT gives the strongest online signal for early stopping, and RL produces the most reliable trace-level signal for aggregation. We further show that confidence reliability is position-dependent: RL confidence becomes informative after a path-commitment phase, while OPD confidence is useful early but can become inversely calibrated later. Based on this observation, we propose PosConf, a position-aware confidence strategy that uses confidence only from reliable relative-position intervals. PosConf improves RL answer aggregation by 6.1 points over majority voting and consistently improves OPD early stopping under tight token budgets, with gains up to 4.3 points by avoiding its later inverse-calibration region, showing that \emph{confidence in reasoning models should be used both stage-wise and position-awarely}. Our code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Post-Training-Calibration.
